resources.string: Use phone WeChat or QQ to scan the official login QR code, use a school app_token, or import an existing session. No social app is needed in the emulator.
Import and log in to Lepao
Both QQ openid and access_token are required.
QQ credentials loaded. You can export them as a QR code or log in.
Invalid QQ credentials. Use a lepao-qq:// URI or QQ JSON with openid and access_token, not WeChat credentials.
No QQ authorization captured. Enable the module for Lepao, restart Lepao, and log in with QQ once on this device.
Could not read QQ authorization. Check root access for the module.

Show the official QQ authorization QR code here and scan with QQ on your phone. After authorization, this device logs in to Lepao automatically. No QQ or WeChat installation is required in the emulator; no phone module is required.
On the other device, open QQ credentials and scan to log in. This QR code contains login credentials; keep it private.
QR generation failed. Check the credential length and try again.
Show official QQ login QR code
Scan the Tencent QR code with QQ on your iPhone or Android phone and approve authorization. Neither QQ nor WeChat is needed in this emulator.
Waiting for phone QQ to scan and authorize. Complete any confirmation shown on the official page.
Authorization was cancelled or did not match this session. Generate a new QR code and try again.
QQ application identity lookup failed. Generate a new QR code to authorize again.
The official QQ page failed to load. Check the network and refresh.
No matching session is bound to this account. Import this account again.
Statistics refresh every 60 seconds while this page is open. History refresh is explicit. Running rules are read-only device snapshots, not a new server verdict.

Detection rules and complain_reason options are not a cheating verdict. Status codes are shown as returned, without inventing undocumented meanings. Missing suspicion fields mean unknown, not cleared. Signed resource URLs and credentials are redacted.
Not queried; term target requires valid running rules
Queries rules for the account currently logged in to Lepao. Lepao must have loaded the updated module. No account switching, re-login or activity submission occurs.
Server rules read for this account.
Rule query timed out. Open Lepao with the updated module loaded.
Lepao is logged in to a different account. Rules were not queried or overwritten.
A rule query is already running.
Host rule query failed. Cumulative statistics are unaffected.
